source_facts: All program details are synthetic and authoritative. Lantern Arts offers a workshop for participants aged 12 through 15 at Studio 6. Enrollment closes at 17:00 on October 8, 2032, using the studio's local time. The fee is $24. A family can request a waiver by selecting the fee assistance checkbox; desk staff grant that waiver without requesting financial documents. Guardian approval is required before enrollment can be confirmed. A reservation code, rather than a submitted form or payment receipt, is the evidence of a confirmed place. There are 18 places. Once those places are allocated, the waitlist is ordered by form-submission timestamp. Refund requests received by 12:00 on October 10, 2032 qualify for the full $24 refund. Later requests do not qualify under this policy. Families report to Studio 6 on arrival. The enrollment desk records a guardian's approval, generates the reservation code after checking it, and uses the same submission timestamp when reviewing a waitlisted form; a later payment must not change waitlist position. Families can submit a form before the guardian approval is recorded, but this alone does not confirm enrollment. Independent reader journeys: the Family handout is sent as a standalone attachment and printed for caregivers; the Enrollment desk card is kept in the staff console and is not included in that attachment. Both audiences need the deadline, fee, confirmation rule, approval requirement, waitlist rule, and refund cutoff locally. A caregiver should not need staff-console access, and a desk worker should not need the family attachment. In the current draft, two adjacent family-handout sentences express the same full-refund rule without adding a condition or serving a separate reader journey.

# Lantern Arts workshop enrollment

## Family handout

Lantern Arts welcomes participants aged 12 through 15. On arrival, report to Studio 6. This handout explains what a family needs to do before treating a workshop place as confirmed. Keep the reservation information available so you can distinguish a confirmed place from a form that is still awaiting approval.

Enrollment closes at 17:00 on October 8, 2032, in the studio's local time. The workshop fee is $24. If you need a waiver, select the fee assistance checkbox on the enrollment form. Financial documents are not required for that request. The checkbox is the route for requesting assistance, rather than a separate payment arrangement to negotiate on arrival.

Guardian approval is required before enrollment can be confirmed. You may submit a form before that approval is recorded, but submitting it does not reserve a confirmed place. A reservation code is the evidence that enrollment is confirmed; a payment receipt alone is not that evidence.

The workshop has 18 places. When they are allocated, the waitlist follows form-submission timestamp order. A later payment does not move a form ahead of an earlier submission. If your form is waitlisted, distinguish its position in that queue from the confirmation represented by a reservation code.

Refund requests received by 12:00 on October 10, 2032 qualify for the full $24 refund. In other words, a refund request received by 12:00 on October 10, 2032 returns the entire $24 fee. Requests received after that cutoff do not qualify under the workshop policy.

## Enrollment desk card

Use this card while processing Lantern Arts enrollment. Enrollment closes at 17:00 on October 8, 2032, in the studio's local time. The fee is $24, and the workshop has 18 places. Check the place allocation before interpreting a submitted form as ready for confirmation. A form can exist in the system before all confirmation conditions are satisfied.

Grant a requested fee waiver without asking for financial documents. The family's fee assistance checkbox records the request. Do not create a separate evidence-gathering step for this waiver; it is not part of the enrollment process.

Record guardian approval before confirming enrollment. Once approval has been checked and a place is available, generate the reservation code. That code is the evidence of a confirmed place. A submitted form or payment receipt does not substitute for it when answering a family's status question.

For a waitlisted form, preserve form-submission timestamp order. Do not replace the original timestamp with the time of a later payment. The queue should reflect when the form entered enrollment, not when another action was taken on its account.

A refund request received by 12:00 on October 10, 2032 qualifies for a full $24 refund. Apply that cutoff to the request's receipt time. A later request does not qualify under this policy, even if the enrollment form itself was submitted before the enrollment deadline. These are separate deadlines for separate actions.
